scope: New factual, numerical and source-description research on external written federal legislative submissions; prioritised leads, not representative sample. Existing three-month census remains incomplete.
original_requirements: Exact addressed draft, context and alternative explanations, explicit policy request, short exact quotes, independent reciprocal AI checks, no inferred intent or invented reviews/responses.

priority_steering.user: Prioritise comparatively short documents and expert statements.
priority_steering.implementation: Prioritise complete short submissions and named experts; do not read hundreds of pages merely because a large PDF exists. Long primary drafts/studies checked through relevant passages, with exact read extents and version limits.
